async def act(page):
    # Sort issues by 'Updated date' to get the latest updated
    sort_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Created date')
    await sort_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to appear
    updated_date_option = page.get_by_role('option', name='Updated date')
    await updated_date_option.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Find issues with 'feature' in the title (case-insensitive)
    feature_issues = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='feature')
    if await feature_issues.count() == 0:
        # If no issues with 'feature' found, return 'no feature issues found'
        return 'no feature issues found'
    # Get the first issue (latest after sorting by updated date)
    first_feature_issue = feature_issues.first
    await first_feature_issue.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Check if the issue is closed by looking for status indicators
    closed_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Reopen issue')
    open_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Close issue')
    if await closed_button.count() > 0:
        status = 'closed'
    elif await open_button.count() > 0:
        status = 'open'
    else:
        # Fallback: look for status text
        status_element = page.get_by_role('status')
        if await status_element.count() > 0:
            status = await status_element.inner_text()
        else:
            status = 'unknown'
    return status
